status: 17.4 mm USB-C-only packaging target with a provisional aluminum rear and insulated battery contact. Requires an unselected display, controller and protected pack. Not a validated build or fabrication-ready enclosure.
axes: x left to right, y top to bottom, z front to back

components.name: Thin display target
components.evidence: Hypothetical 6.8 mm panel assembly. No matching panel, touch assembly, connector or driver is selected. This is not the 14.04 mm Waveshare stock assembly scaled down.

components.name: Custom 35-key thumb keyboard target
components.evidence: Custom 35-key planning envelope, not the KeebDeck footprint. Key mechanism, matrix, caps, PCB and retainer remain undesigned.

components.name: Protected pouch battery reservation
components.evidence: Unselected protected pack envelope including protection, lead exit and NTC. Capacity unknown. A separate 0.8 mm front expansion allowance and 0.2 mm rear insulating thermal interface are provisional until the pack supplier approves the stack.

components.name: Power PCB reservation
components.evidence: Reserved component envelope. Routing, thermal copper, connectors and height remain unresolved.

components.name: Orange Pi Zero 2W reservation
components.evidence: 65 x 30 mm PCB size is published. The 7 mm populated reservation retains the existing sockets. No height saving is claimed from hiding external ports. Internal HDMI/USB cables, antenna clearance and heat path still need measurement.

components.name: Separate HDMI controller target
components.evidence: Hypothetical controller envelope beside the battery. No compatible HDMI-to-panel controller has been selected or verified within this size.

components.evidence: Supplier-listed 25 x 22 x 11 mm module represented by a bounding box. No detailed module CAD or mounting geometry is imported. Supplier listing currently has no stock.

unresolved: 17.4 mm is a packaging target, not an achieved thickness. Component and connector meshes are planning envelopes.
The 1.0 mm aluminum rear requires stiffness, fastening, edge and drop checks; it is not a manufacturing specification.
The existing 14.04 mm Waveshare display cannot occupy the 6.8 mm panel target. No manufacturer geometry is scaled.
A thin display/touch assembly and matched separate HDMI controller must be sourced and tested at the required resolution.
Only USB-C is externally accessible. The Orange Pi sockets and internal HDMI/USB links still occupy space. No socket removal is assumed.
USB-C opening and connector/cable keepout are provisional. Internal HDMI/USB plugs, panel flex routing, cable bends and strain relief remain unmodeled and may enlarge the device.

The 0.2 mm divider, 0.8 mm forward pack expansion clearance and 0.2 mm insulating thermal interface are separate reservations. Their materials, tolerances, swelling allowance and contact pressure require pack-supplier approval.

The rear must never clamp the pouch. Do not use bare aluminum contact or route CPU/converter heat through the battery. A shared aluminum rear can transfer heat into the pack and requires closed-case temperature measurements.
The 58 x 82 x 7 mm protected pack is unselected; capacity, current rating, protection, lead exit and NTC require a supplier drawing.
PIM447 sourcing, mounting holes, ball protrusion, click travel, cleaning access and wiring require a purchased module and measurements.
The 35-key keyboard needs key mechanics, contacts, a retainer and physical typing tests.
The 4 mm planar gap between power and display-controller reservations may not fit actual cables and thermal requirements.
Antenna position and a polymer RF window or antenna beyond the aluminum rear must be established from the exact SBC revision. The full rear plate is a material study, not a validated RF design.
Screws, mounts, battery retention and heat-spreader routing remain undesigned. Screws and sharp edges must remain outside the pouch and its expansion volume.

battery_stack.contact_policy: The pack contacts the rear through an electrically insulating thermal interface. Retention must not compress the pouch; expansion is reserved toward the front. Bare aluminum contact and routing SBC or converter heat through the pack are excluded.

external_ports.name: USB-C charge input
external_ports.evidence: One external connector. Opening and connector/cable allowance are provisional until a receptacle and mating plug are selected. Touch, keyboard, HDMI, storage and debug connections remain internal.
